form.label: Thresholds
form.description: Add, change or delete the silence threshold of an index (or an index pattern such as app_*). Click a row of the lookup to load it into the form, then press Apply. A new rule is inserted before the first wildcard rule so it takes precedence over "*".

search.query: | inputlookup idxmon_thresholds | streamstats count as rn | eval new=0 | eventstats min(eval(if(like(index,"%*%"),rn,null()))) as fw | append [| makeresults | eval index=$f_index|s$, threshold_minutes=$f_thr|s$, enabled=$f_enabled|s$, severity=$f_sev|s$, owner=$f_owner|s$, comment=$f_comment|s$, new=1 | fields - _time] | eval idx_l=lower(trim(index)), index=trim(index) | eventstats max(rn) as old_rn, max(new) as hasnew by idx_l | eventstats max(fw) as fw_all | eval pos=case(new=0, rn, isnotnull(old_rn), old_rn, isnotnull(fw_all), fw_all-0.5, true(), 1000000) | where new=1 OR hasnew=0 | where NOT (new=1 AND "$f_action$"="delete") | where len(index)>0 | sort 0 pos | fields index threshold_minutes enabled severity owner comment | outputlookup idxmon_thresholds.csv

panel.title: Lookup idxmon_thresholds (rule order matters - click a row to edit it)
Effective threshold per index (reload the page after a change)

search.query: | `idxmon_status` | table index threshold_minutes enabled severity owner comment | sort index | rename index as Index, threshold_minutes as "Threshold (min)", enabled as Enabled, severity as Severity, owner as Owner, comment as Comment
